title: Finite-Dimensional Davies Interface Lemmas and TFIM Witness Tests for the Heisenberg Cut as a Resource Boundary
author: Lluis Eriksson
headline: SUPERSEDED BY AI.VIXRA:2601.0023V2
summary: This replacement preserves public version 1 and adds an explicit correction and supersession record. The affected Davies-channel Bohr decomposition, zero-frequency identity, constants, proof interfaces and TFIM witness interpretation must not be used from version 1 without the corrections in ai.viXra:2601.0023v2.

The historical paper is not erased. Its motivating resource-boundary discussion and finite-system witness programme remain provenance, while the corrected finite-dimensional lemmas and hypotheses are controlled by the successor.
citation_rule: For the corrected Davies interface lemmas, constants and TFIM witness implementation, cite ai.viXra:2601.0023v2. Cite this record only for historical provenance, together with this supersession notice.
status_boundary: SUPERSEDED does not mean that every sentence of version 1 is false. It means that load-bearing technical statements were corrected in the named successor and version 1 is no longer the authoritative mathematical source for them.
retained: The operational motivation connecting coherence maintenance, finite control resources and finite-dimensional tests remains a programme-level interpretation.
The finite TFIM exact-diagonalization witness protocol remains a historical numerical test design, subject to the corrected observable and normalization conventions.
No thermodynamic, continuum or universal resource-boundary theorem is retained from the finite tests alone.
superseded: The printed Davies Bohr-sector decomposition and the affected zero-frequency Dirichlet identity are superseded where the successor records proof corrections.
Envelope constants and inheritance statements are superseded; a separation-dependent lower envelope requires explicit infrared and quasi-local tail hypotheses.
The inline appendix/listing and any numerical conclusions depending on the superseded normalization are not authoritative.
successor_adds: A corrected finite-dimensional Davies-channel decomposition and omega=0 identity.
Corrected constants and explicit hypotheses for envelope inheritance.
A compact, machine-verified finite TFIM witness implementation with narrower conclusions.
evidence: The surviving lemmas are exact finite-dimensional statements under named hypotheses; the TFIM tests are finite numerical or machine-verified evidence. No general lower envelope follows without the successor's assumptions.
provenance: Notice pages 1-2 are new. The following 22 pages reproduce public version 1 with identical rendered content. Frozen copies of both public v1 and the public successor v2 are included in the audited package.
